{{Top|leg}}
'''Bantha''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Bantha commented on the entry for the [[.48-caliber Enforcer pistol]], noting that [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] ammunition could be modified with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]]. Bantha was also a proponent of using a [[Riot gun/Legends|riot gun]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
